ValidationRule.description: Prohibits Bank Data records from being edited if they were created through a Credit Review (exception for editing the Yodlee Banks field), or if Yodlee has already been Completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( Related_to_Credit_Review__c=TRUE, OR( ISCHANGED(Account_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Routing_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Bank_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), AND( ISCHANGED(Yodlee_Banks__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Yodlee_Banks__c))) ) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c,"Completed"), OR( ISCHANGED(Account_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Routing_Number__c), ISCHANGED(Bank_Name__c), ISCHANGED(Account__c), AND( ISCHANGED(Yodlee_Banks__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Yodlee_Banks__c))) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Bank Data records cannot be edited. Please create a new Bank Data record for this Bank Account.
